Privacy Policy

This prelaunch website is designed to collect no personal information through forms. If analytics, contact forms, call tracking, advertising, or other data collection tools are added later, this policy must be updated before those tools are enabled.

Prelaunch build: This deployment is intentionally set to noindex. Add the final domain and verified contact details in content/site.json before switching production_ready to true.

Server and hosting data

Hosting providers may process standard technical information required to deliver and secure the website, such as IP addresses, request logs, browser information, and security events.

Contact forms

No public contact form is enabled in the prelaunch build. If one is added later, this policy should state what information is collected, why it is collected, and how it is handled.

Analytics and cookies

No analytics platform is assumed in this starter build. Any analytics or advertising tools added later should be disclosed here as appropriate.

Policy updates

This page should be reviewed whenever the site's data collection, advertising, contact, or analytics setup changes.
